# Wider status display test font

This is a modified copy of the Roboto Regular test face shipped with the [font source](../font-source/type/).
HarfBuzz subset it to the status display's letters, digits, colon, space and ellipsis. FontTools expanded
the glyph contours, advances and left side bearings horizontally by 1.5. It is an edit fixture for the
submitted-frame publication test. [Apache 2.0 license](LICENSE.txt)
